prerequisites: It is recommended to have acquired competencies in Physics, Mathematics, and Strength of Materials.

learning_outcomes.text: Capacity for the drafting, signing and development of projects in the field of industrial engineering, whose purpose is the construction, reform, repair, conservation, demolition, manufacturing, installation, assembly or operation of: structures, mechanical equipment, energy installations, electrical and electronic installations, industrial installations and plants, and manufacturing and automation processes.
Capacity for the direction of activities subject to engineering projects described in competence G01.

syllabus_topics: 1.1. Legal Regulatory Framework: CTE DB-SI, RSCIEI
2.1. Legal Regulatory Framework: CTE DB-HS, CTE DB-HE, RITE
3.1. Legal Regulatory Framework: REBT, CTE DB-HE

assessment_methods.method: Design, calculation, and dimensioning of a low voltage and lighting installation for an industrial building.
Design, calculation, and dimensioning of passive and active fire protection systems for an industrial building.

Design, calculation, and dimensioning of a sanitation installation (water supply, domestic hot water and solar contribution, rainwater, wastewater, and industrial water evacuation, ventilation) for an industrial building.
Oral presentation of the designed, calculated, and dimensioned installations.
